scope: DEVELOPER/CONSUMER API surface — no browser UX (UX_REQUIRED=never)

1_public_exports_from_index_ts.notes: index.ts exports only: 4 generator functions, 5 problem/root types, 2 PRNG/Fraction utilities, 2 expression-builder formatters. No accidental internal helpers leaked (no randInt, randNonZero, formatBinomial, Case, etc.). Clean section grouping: 'Core algebra generators (T17)' and 'Core algebra utilities (T17)'.

2_generator_api_consistency.notes: All four generators accept {seed: number} and return domain-specific problem objects. Minor shape divergence: LinearEquationProblem and SystemOfEquationsProblem include familyId ('step-by-step-solver:linear-equation' / 'step-by-step-solver:system-of-equations'); QuadraticFactoringProblem and QuadraticFormulaProblem omit familyId. This matches the existing codebase precedent (ExpLogProblem has familyId, PolynomialOperation does not). The step-by-step-solver component only needs familyId for the linear/systems fallback; quadratics have dedicated rendering paths. Not a bug.

3_adapter_key_naming.notes: New keys: 'linear-equation-solver', 'system-of-equations-solver', 'quadratic-factoring', 'quadratic-formula'. Existing keys: 'polynomial-operations', 'polynomial-division', 'rational-analyzer', 'exp-log-solver'. All follow kebab-case domain-descriptive convention. Consistent.

4_solution_steps_readability.notes: All generators produce 3-6 human-readable steps. Linear: original → isolated → solution. Systems: system statement → method → determinant → x → substitution → y. Factoring: standard form → factor pair → rewrite → group → factored form. Formula: coefficients → discriminant → root type → quadratic formula → simplify. No raw code, no unhelpful jargon. Steps include intermediate values (e.g., 'a*c = 12', 'Determinant is 7') for step-by-step UI display.

5_type_exports.notes: All problem types exported from index.ts: LinearEquationProblem, SystemOfEquationsProblem, QuadraticFactoringProblem, QuadraticFormulaProblem, QuadraticFormulaRoot. Consumers can import types for type-safe integration.

6_jsdoc_documentation.notes: All four generators have module-level JSDoc describing strategy (backward-construction, determinism, single-pass), and function-level JSDoc with @param and @returns. Linear/systems module docs are most detailed (FR-8 reference, exact backward-gen walkthrough). Factoring/formula docs are adequate (describe regimes/modes). Adapters have file-level JSDoc explaining the wrapping pattern.

7_grading_rules_spec_compliance.notes: quadratic-factoring: partGradingRules.factoredForm = 'expression_equivalence' (spec §3 compliant — (x+3)(x-2) and (x-2)(x+3) both accepted). quadratic-formula: discriminant gets 'numeric_tolerance' (1e-9), numeric roots get 'numeric_tolerance', radical/complex strings get 'exact_match'. Linear: 'numeric_tolerance' with 1e-9. Systems: both x and y 'numeric_tolerance' with 1e-9. All appropriate.

8_style_consistency.notes: New generators follow exp-log-solver.ts structure: section separators (//---), Types/Helpers/Main generator sections, same randInt/randNonZero helper pattern. Uses mulberry32 (not seededRandom) as planned. algebra-generators-adapters.ts mirrors advanced-math-adapters.ts pattern: key/nodeIds/description/generate contract, GeneratorOutput construction with prompt/data/expectedAnswer/solutionSteps/gradingMetadata. DRY violation (randInt/randNonZero duplicated in 4 files) is pre-existing pattern from exp-log-solver; not introduced by T17.

bug_found_and_fixed.fix_description: Narrowed Record<string, string> to the GradingMetadata union type.
